## The premise

<!--
Pitch the change from the player's or contributor's point of view. What becomes
possible or better, why is that appealing, and how does it fit the game? Write
this as natural prose, not a ticket summary or commit log.
-->

## How it works

<!--
Explain the behavior concretely. Include rules, odds, limits, compatibility
details, deliberate exclusions, and safeguards when they matter.
-->

## What changes

<!--
Show the actual content affected. Use a readable table or list when the change
adds or redistributes species, encounters, items, moves, maps, or other game
content. Include where, odds, and conditions when applicable. Remove this
section when the previous sections already cover a small change completely.
-->

## Design decisions

<!--
Explain the meaningful tradeoffs behind the implementation, especially choices
about balance, theme, progression, or compatibility. Remove this section if
there are no non-obvious decisions to discuss.
-->

## Screenshots

<!--
Add before/after screenshots for visual changes. Remove this section when the
change has no useful visual comparison.
-->

## Verification

<!--
List the checks that actually ran and their results, including relevant local
tests and CI. Mention important coverage gaps honestly. Do not claim pending or
unrun checks as passing.
-->
